sections.content: How many students stayed in Carlton in Lindrick after school?
Carlton in Lindrick is a small town in the East Midlands. Carlton in Lindrick does not have a university.
In Carlton in Lindrick, [description of cluster]. In this analysis, we’ve referred to towns like this as 1.

How many students left Carlton in Lindrick?

Of those who got degrees, 50% were living outside of Carlton in Lindrick in 2018/19.

Of those who completed other post-18 education, 41% were living outside Carlton in Lindrick in 2018/19.

However, some people who moved away from Carlton in Lindrick stayed within the same travel to work area, a larger area that includes where most of the local working population both live and work. Of all graduates that sat their GCSEs in Carlton in Lindrick, 67% remained in the same travel to work area in 2018/19, while 33% moved further afield.

89% of skilled non-graduates from Carlton in Lindrick stayed in the same travel to work area in 2018/19, while 11% moved further afield.
25% of graduates were living in another English region in 2018/19.
